verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with a case-preparation platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions. The eligibility questionnaires and case-manager guidance are not described as AI-driven, and the platform is only documented as handling document upload and readiness tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
